Habitat nace por el año 2022, en un luga: Habitat was born around 2022, in a small place on César Díaz Street 5475. Literally in that “Upper Room”, because it was on the second floor. There, several young people, with the pastoral support of a local church, joined together in prayer and worship, simply seeking the presence of God.
En el transcurso de los meses, muchas ex: Over the months, many experiences kept confirming that God wanted to do something among us. Little by little, God was directing us toward establishing Habitat, a ministry training space for pastors and leaders. Like every beginning, it took a lot of effort, dedication and even all our resources, trusting that God is the Lord of the work and that it is not ours.
Con el tiempo más estudiantes fueron sum: Over time more students joined, God multiplied His work and in 2025 we moved to a larger place. That year, more than 100 students chose to prepare through our programs, and God moved supernaturally among all of us, bringing tools, activation and momentum so the Kingdom of heaven keeps advancing.
¡Hoy podemos disfrutar de todo lo que Di: Today we can enjoy everything God did, does and will keep doing! We count on your prayers too; without them, we could not have come this far.
Lo que cuidamos en cada paso: What we care for at every step
Reconocemos el valor y la dignidad de ca: We recognize the value and dignity of every person. Just as God shows no partiality, we believe that everyone who seeks to grow, serve and be transformed has a place in this training space.
Entendemos la formación ministerial como: We see ministry training as a path of service. Following the example of Jesus, we embrace humility as a discipline of the heart and a sign of spiritual maturity: learning to serve before being served.
Formamos personas apasionadas por Dios y: We train people who are passionate about God and His purpose, and also committed to persevering in the process. We seek a passion that is sustained in daily obedience.
La Biblia es la inspirada, infalible, in: The Bible is the inspired, infallible, inerrant and authoritative Word of God.
Hay un solo Dios, que existe eternamente: There is one God, who exists eternally in three persons: Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
Jesucristo es el eterno Hijo de Dios, co: Jesus Christ is the eternal Son of God, fully God and fully human. He was born of a virgin, lived a sinless life, died as the sacrificial substitute to pay the penalty of sin, rose physically from the dead, ascended into heaven, and He will physically return again.
Dios creó al hombre y la mujer en Su per: God created man and woman in His perfect image, with equality across ethnicities.
Toda la humanidad, excluyendo a Cristo,: All humanity, except Christ, is sinful both by birth and by action. The wages of sin are physical and spiritual death.
Creemos en la salvación del pecado: We believe in salvation from sin
La salvación del pecado viene solo como: Salvation from sin comes only as a gift of God through faith in Jesus Christ and His sacrifice for sin.
Creemos en la segunda venida de Cristo: We believe in the second coming of Christ
Evento que manifestará Su regreso a la t: An event that will manifest His return to earth in a personal and visible way, with the purpose of consummating His Kingdom. We believe the Church will be caught up and transformed, receiving a glorified body to reign with Jesus over the nations.
Todo lo que Dios hace, lo hace en famili: Everything God does, He does as a family
Nuestro equipo directivo está formado po: Our leadership team is made up of the married couple Guido Dalé and Agustina Griotto, together with Daiana Nieto. With hearts passionate about serving and a determination to equip the saints, each of them trained at different Bible seminaries to have tools for leading and training new leaders.

En esta escuela ministerial 2025 nos enf: In this 2025 ministry school we will focus, along with practical sessions and personal mentoring, on holistic training in biblical aspects, ministry principles and foundations, and the supernatural dynamics of the Kingdom of God on earth.
La escuela del desierto, es un programa: The School of the Desert is a ministry training program where we will go deeper into how this place and its different dynamics affect us in order to shape us.
Disciplinas Espirituales y Movimientos d: Spiritual Disciplines and Moves of God
En nuestra Escuela Maranata abordaremos: In our Maranatha School we will cover a theological introduction to biblical eschatology, giving value and discernment about the different views, as well as the whole book of Revelation along with the 150 chapters that speak about the end times.
En este programa estaremos viendo los at: In this program we will look at the attributes of God and how they build us up for holistic growth and a broader knowledge of His person.
En esta escuela ministerial online, abor: In this online ministry school, we will go deep into the path to remain in freedom as children of God and enjoy the inheritance God has given us.
En este programa estaremos viendo sobre: In this program we will look at the leadership of Jesus and how to cultivate it in a healthy and effective way, so that the gospel of the Kingdom spreads.
En este curso abordaremos cómo un caráct: In this course we will look at how tested character, a healthy identity and a firm purpose shape the Christian walk and the endurance of the Christian faith. At Habitat, we see these three qualities as the pillars for developing every other topic we work on.
En este curso abordaremos en profundidad: In this course we will look in depth at God’s Plan for His creation; we will also see how sin came about and its influence, and finally we will talk about the heart and its desires. The goal is to give an overview of that plan and offer tools to live consistently with it in a practical way.
En este curso gratuito y sencillo, abord: In this free and simple course, we will look in a practical way at how to put a sermon together and the key points for developing and delivering it.

Para entrar al Campus o al juego guardam: To sign in to the Campus or the game we keep your name, your email and, if you choose one, your profile photo. If you sign in with Google or Facebook, they share your name, email and photo with us. Wix stores your password encrypted, and nobody at Habitat can see it.
Para acompañarte en tu formación guardam: To support you in your training we keep:
los cursos, escuelas y carreras en los q: the courses, schools and programs you're enrolled in, the classes you watched and your in-person or Zoom attendance;
tus desafíos, exámenes, trabajos práctic: your challenges, exams, assignments and grades;
lo que escribís en el Campus: preguntas: what you write on the Campus: questions in classes, your spiritual journal, prayer requests, testimonies and feedback on classes.

Cuando te inscribís, te sumás como volun: When you enroll, volunteer, join Sembradores or leave us a message, we keep what you fill in: name, email, phone, your church and whatever you tell us. We use it to reply to you and to organize ourselves.
Para preparar y enviar tu pedido guardam: To prepare and ship your order we keep your name, your ID number, your phone and the shipping address. We share it with whoever delivers it and use it to locate the address on the map.
Los pagos de cuotas, cursos, el libro y: Payments for fees, courses, the book and the Kids & Hero subscription are processed by Mercado Pago. Your card details are entered with Mercado Pago, and Habitat never sees or stores them. We receive the confirmation, amount and date of the payment.
La web guarda en tu navegador el idioma: The site stores in your browser the language you chose, your signed-in session and a copy of your game progress, so everything loads faster and you don't have to choose every time. You can delete it anytime from your browser settings. The site loads its fonts from Google Fonts.
